q1.sampleAnswer: The owl’s name is Poldi and the dog’s name is Ingo.

keyPoints.descZh: 猫头鹰叫 Poldi，狗叫 Ingo
examples: The owl’s name is Poldi and the dog’s name is Ingo.

q1.rubricZh: 要点：猫头鹰 Poldi，狗 Ingo（两个名字都要答出）。
q1.explanationZh: 第二段开头 Poldi, the owl, met the dog, Ingo，所以猫头鹰是 Poldi，狗是 Ingo。

evidence.quote: Poldi, the owl, met the dog, Ingo

q2.sampleAnswer: They became friends when Brandt adopted Poldi and brought him home.

keyPoints.descZh: Brandt 收养了猫头鹰并把它带回家，两只动物相遇后成为朋友
examples: when Brandt adopted the owl and brought him home

q2.rubricZh: 要点：Brandt 收养猫头鹰并带回家，两者相遇后成为朋友。
q2.explanationZh: Brandt 把猫头鹰领养回家，它就遇见了小狗，很快两个小家伙就成了朋友。

evidence.quote: when Brandt adopted the owl and brought him home

q3.sampleAnswer: He might give the dog a quick bite on the ear.

examples: give Ingo a quick bite on the ear

q3.rubricZh: 要点：快速轻咬狗的耳朵。
q3.explanationZh: 第二段说猫头鹰想要关注时，会轻轻咬一下 Ingo 的耳朵。

evidence.quote: he might give Ingo a quick bite on the ear

q4.sampleAnswer: Because he wanted to protect his friend and to tell the other owl to go away.

examples: he wanted to protect his friend
tell the other owl to go away

q4.rubricZh: 要点：保护朋友；叫另一只猫头鹰走开（答出其一意思即可酌情给分）。
q4.explanationZh: Brandt 说 Poldi 好像在说“离我的朋友远点”，所以它是想保护朋友、赶走另一只猫头鹰。

evidence.quote: “It was as if he were saying, ‘Back off from my friend’,”

q5.sampleAnswer: Poldi was the “boss” in the friendship.
q5.explanationZh: 最后一句 Brandt 说 Poldi 虽然个子小，但它才是老大。

evidence.quote: Poldi may have been smaller, but he was the boss

q6.sampleAnswer: Yes, my family has a cat and a bird. They live together peacefully in our house. Sometimes they even eat from their bowls side by side. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 回答自己见过的动物友谊并简单描述
examples: Yes, my family has a cat and a bird. They live together peacefully.

q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题，说说你见过哪些动物成了朋友，再用一两句话描述它们怎么相处就可以。
